newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco aluminium output up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco aluminium output up in 1996.

text.p: Aluminium producer Comalco Ltd, controlled by the RTZ-CRA group, said on Wednesday its primary aluminium production rose to 475,804 tonnes in 1996 from 438,081 in 1995.
Production in the three months to December 31 totalled 127,937 tonnes, up from 111,042 tonnes a year earlier.

"Higher primary aluminium production was due to a higher number of cells operating at the Bell Bay (Tasmania) smelter and increased line current on existing cells and new cells coming on line as part of the upgrade at the Tiwai Point smelter in New Zealand," Comalco said in its fourth quarter production report.
Sales of aluminium rose to 468,859 tonnes from 431,417 a year earlier.
"The increase in primary aluminium sales is due to the extra metal production and timing of shipments," the company said.
